description: This file declares the NotifyWPEFramework class within the WPEFramework::JavaScript::Functions namespace. The class appears to handle JavaScript messaging related to notifications, specifically for the WPEFramework platform, including a method to process messages and a static method to get a notification message name.

classes.name: NotifyWPEFramework
classes.description: Handles JavaScript message processing and notification name retrieval within the WPEFramework JavaScript interface.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Processes JavaScript messages received in the context, arguments, and returns a JSValueRef result.
